meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: Claude 会按你指定的时间范围在 Lark 中查找会议，获取对应的会议纪要，整理成结构化报告（单日概览或周报），并可应你要求将报告生成或追加到云文档。
howto.when: 当你提出整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内会议内容等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要

say.note: 会汇总上周会议并给出报告

howto.what_en: Claude will search for meetings in Lark within a specified time range, retrieve the associated meeting notes, and compile them into a structured report (daily overview or weekly summary). It can optionally create or append the report to a cloud document.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to organize meeting notes, generate a weekly meeting summary, or review meeting content from a period.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting notes.
say_en.note: Generates a weekly meeting summary report.

say_en.text: Show me which meetings happened today.
Create last week's meeting summary report.
